es419.note: Piso (flat) is Spain's word. Latin America usually says apartamento or departamento.

tandemSoGehts: Cut the cards in the middle. Partner A takes the left half, Partner B takes the right half.
A builds question 1 from the tiles and asks it: “¿Cómo es tu jefe?” (Put the verb in the right form.)

B hears the question and builds the answer. The blue tile is an adjective. Before a noun it may lose its ending: bueno → buen, malo → mal, primero → primer, tercero → tercer, alguno → algún, ninguno → ningún. Gran is short before any singular noun. After the noun, the adjective keeps its full form.
Then B asks question 2 and A answers. Take turns. At the end, check with the answer sheet.
Last, swap cards and do it all again, faster.

tandemRedemittel.p2: Es un buen … / Es una gran …
Buen delante de un nombre masculino: un buen jefe. Una buena idea no cambia.
